Public domain: every person whose words are in this text died in 1925 or earlier, so the term has ended under the law of every country, whichever one first published it.

People: Luigi Lanzi (author, Wikidata Q972400), died 1810; Thomas Roscoe (translator, Wikidata Q16065601), died 1871. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Lanzi, Luigi, 1732-1810; Roscoe, Thomas, 1791-1871 [Translator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: The history of painting in Italy, London, 1854, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/historypainting00lanzgoog. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 66%, 97%, 100% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Luigi Lanzi, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
